title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: 36. Calls on the Member States and the Commission to base any approach to natural predation on science and stakeholder consultations, including preventive and targeted management measures for great cormorants and grey seals, ensuring that any measures adopted are effective, fulfil all legal obligations, and include adequate monitoring, dedicated and adequate funding and strengthened stakeholder cooperation, to ensure the effectiveness of the implemented measures, including mitigation practices such as deterrents or physical exclusion;
